feed.title: Whatsitcalled: new and updated terms
feed.subtitle: A community glossary for Microsoft 365: SharePoint, Power Platform and Copilot.

entry.title: Updated: Adaptive Card
entry.summary: An Adaptive Card is a small, tidy panel with text, pictures and buttons that appears inside a chat, like a mini form.

entry.title: Updated: Agent 365
entry.summary: Agent 365 is a control panel for the AI agents an organisation uses, so someone can see them and keep them in check.

entry.title: Updated: Agentic AI
entry.summary: Agentic AI is AI that can work through several steps to reach a goal, instead of just answering one question.

entry.title: Updated: AI Builder
entry.summary: AI Builder lets you add ready-made AI skills, such as reading text from a form, to apps and flows without needing data science knowledge.

entry.title: Updated: AI model
entry.summary: An AI model is the trained "brain" inside an AI tool: it has learned patterns from lots of examples and uses them to produce an answer.

entry.title: Updated: AI safety
entry.summary: AI safety is the set of habits and controls that stop an AI from causing harm or doing something unexpected.

entry.title: Updated: AI-generated content
entry.summary: AI-generated content is anything an AI wrote or made for you: text, images, summaries, code and so on.

entry.title: Updated: Analyst
entry.summary: Analyst is a ready-made Copilot helper that is good at working with numbers and data.

entry.title: Updated: App context
entry.summary: App context is what Copilot can see about the thing you have open, such as the current document or email.

entry.title: Updated: Authentication
entry.summary: Authentication is proving who you are, like showing your pass at the entrance.

entry.title: Updated: Authorisation
entry.summary: Authorisation decides what a person, Copilot or an agent is allowed to do once it is known who they are.

entry.title: Updated: Autopilot
entry.summary: Autopilot is an AI helper that lives in your organisation and keeps working on its own between your requests, like a colleague with a standing job.

entry.title: Updated: Azure AI Foundry
entry.summary: Azure AI Foundry is Microsoft's workshop in the cloud for building, testing and running AI applications and agents.

entry.title: Updated: Background task
entry.summary: A background task is work an agent keeps doing while you get on with something else.

entry.title: Updated: Bring your own data
entry.summary: Bring your own data means plugging your organisation's own information into an AI tool so its answers fit your business.

entry.title: Updated: Browser context
entry.summary: Browser context is the web page you are looking at, shared with an AI helper when you allow it.

entry.title: Updated: Business Chat
entry.summary: Business Chat is an older name for the Copilot chat that could draw on your work information across apps.

entry.title: Updated: Business data
entry.summary: Business data is the information a company holds about its work: documents, emails, meetings, reports and records.

entry.title: Updated: Business process
entry.summary: A business process is a repeatable set of steps that gets a job done, like approving an expense.

entry.title: Updated: Business system
entry.summary: A business system is a company's main working software, such as customer, finance or HR systems.

entry.title: Updated: Citation
entry.summary: A citation is a pointer in an answer that shows where a statement came from, like a footnote.

entry.title: Updated: Context
entry.summary: Context is the background information given to an AI along with your question, so it can answer sensibly.

entry.title: Updated: Context window
entry.summary: The context window is how much an AI can keep in mind at once, like the size of its desk.

entry.title: Updated: Conversation history
entry.summary: Conversation history is the earlier part of a chat, which the AI reads so follow-up questions make sense.

entry.title: Updated: Copilot
entry.summary: Copilot is Microsoft's name for the AI helpers built into its products, from Word and Teams to Windows and Azure.

entry.title: Updated: Copilot Control System
entry.summary: The Copilot Control System is the collection of admin tools for keeping Copilot and agents safe, managed and measured.

entry.title: Updated: Copilot Credits
entry.summary: Copilot Credits are the units you spend when you use the more advanced, usage-billed parts of Copilot, a bit like top-up credit on a phone.

entry.title: Updated: Copilot Dashboard
entry.summary: The Copilot Dashboard is a report that shows how much Copilot is being used and what difference it makes.

entry.title: Updated: Copilot in Excel
entry.summary: Copilot in Excel is an AI helper inside spreadsheets that can explain numbers and write formulas for you.

entry.title: Updated: Copilot in Outlook
entry.summary: Copilot in Outlook is an AI helper in your email that can draft replies and summarise long threads.

entry.title: Updated: Copilot in PowerPoint
entry.summary: Copilot in PowerPoint is an AI helper that can build and polish slide decks from your ideas or documents.

entry.title: Updated: Copilot in Teams
entry.summary: Copilot in Teams is an AI helper for meetings and chats that can summarise what was said and list actions.

entry.title: Updated: Copilot in Word
entry.summary: Copilot in Word is an AI writing helper that can draft, rewrite and summarise documents for you.

entry.title: Updated: Copilot Notebooks
entry.summary: A Copilot Notebook is a place where you collect the files and notes for one topic so the AI can focus only on them.

entry.title: Updated: Copilot Pages
entry.summary: Copilot Pages are shared pages where you keep the good bits of an AI chat and keep working on them with others.

entry.title: Updated: Cowork
entry.summary: Cowork is a Copilot mode where you describe a whole job and the AI plans it, does the steps across your tools and hands back a finished result.

entry.title: Updated: Customer Conversation harness
entry.summary: The Customer Conversation harness is the engine for agents that talk to your customers, not your staff.

entry.title: Updated: Data boundary
entry.summary: A data boundary is a line around where your organisation's data may be stored and processed, like a country border for information.

entry.title: Updated: Data loss prevention
entry.summary: Data loss prevention is a set of rules that stop sensitive information being shared where it should not be.

entry.title: Updated: Data minimisation
entry.summary: Data minimisation means using only the information you really need for the job, and no more.

entry.title: Updated: Data source
entry.summary: A data source is any place an AI helper can look things up, such as SharePoint, email or a database.

entry.title: Updated: Deep research
entry.summary: Deep research is when an AI spends longer digging through many sources and then writes a thorough report, instead of giving a quick reply.

entry.title: Updated: Desktop flow
entry.summary: A desktop flow copies the clicks and typing a person would do on a computer, so a repetitive task, like copying details between two old programs, can run on its own.

entry.title: Updated: Draft
entry.summary: A draft is a first version written by AI that you are meant to read and improve.

entry.title: Updated: Dynamic grounding
entry.summary: Dynamic grounding means the AI looks up the latest facts at the moment you ask, instead of using only what it already knew.

entry.title: Updated: eDiscovery
entry.summary: eDiscovery is how organisations find and collect electronic information for legal or investigation needs.

entry.title: Updated: Embedding
entry.summary: An embedding is a list of numbers that captures the meaning of some text, so a computer can tell what is similar.

entry.title: Updated: Enterprise data protection
entry.summary: Enterprise data protection is the set of safeguards that keeps your prompts and answers within your organisation's protections.

entry.title: Updated: Evaluation
entry.summary: Evaluation is testing an AI helper to see whether its answers are good enough.

entry.title: Updated: Everyday AI and advanced AI
entry.summary: Microsoft splits Copilot into two kinds of work: everyday AI, which your licence already pays for, and advanced AI, which you pay for as you use it.
